summary: Implement backend canister fetching of stocks data from Worker 0 endpoint and store the returned JSON as-is (no batching, merge, or sorting).
architectural_notes: Only valid stock endpoints are: http://api.assetsbag.com/stocks.json, http://api1.assetsbag.com/stocks.json, http://api2.assetsbag.com/stocks.json, http://api3.assetsbag.com/stocks.json (no *_chunk#.json endpoints).
Worker 0 stocks.json response size is ~1.03MB (intended to fit under IC ~2MB HTTP outcall response limit).
known_issues: IC HTTP outcalls previously failed with IC0504 because canister wuhme-3aaaa-aaaao-a5aga-cai ran out of cycles (causing stocks fetch failures).

existing_features.title: Update the frontend Stocks market data path used by the Add-Asset search so it uses the new backend Worker0 stocks fetch/store/inspect flow (single endpoint only), and ensure the UI does not perform or describe any merge or marketCap-based sorting for stocks.

new_feature_requests.summary: Backend canister: fetch Worker 0 stocks.json (http://api.assetsbag.com/stocks.json) in a single request and store the returned map as-is (no batching/merge/sort)

Implement a backend canister flow to fetch Worker 0 stocks JSON from `api.assetsbag.com/stocks.json` in a single HTTP outcall (no batching/chunking), then store the returned JSON response body as-is for later inspection/use (same overall fetch→validate→store pattern used for FIAT/Commodities).

projectName: Fetch Worker0 stocks.json in backend and use it for Stocks asset search (no merge/sort/batching)
